questions.q: How many Receivables system options records exist for a company with three business units transacting in Receivables?
options: One, shared across the whole installation
questions.explain: System options are configured per business unit, so each business unit that processes Receivables transactions gets its own record.

questions.q: Which category of system options holds the AutoAccounting rule set and the ledger a business unit posts to?
questions.explain: The Accounting group of system options is where the AutoAccounting rule set and the ledger assignment live.

options: It builds General Ledger account segments for transaction lines from sources like transaction type or salesperson
questions.explain: AutoAccounting derives each GL account segment (revenue, receivable, tax, freight, and more) from an attribute you choose per segment.

questions.q: In the Northwind US example, what determines the Revenue account's natural account segment?
options: The transaction type used on the invoice
questions.explain: The example configures AutoAccounting to source the Revenue segment from the transaction type, so every invoice of that type derives the same revenue account.

questions.q: Which group of system options covers the default account for unapplied or unidentified receipts?
questions.explain: Cash processing options include defaults for unapplied and unidentified receipt accounts, along with related receipt behavior.
